# Three.js 0.180.0

Source package: `three@0.180.0`, https://github.com/mrdoob/three/tree/r180.
MIT license in `LICENSE`. Vendored from the user's existing local dependency.

Included: minified WebGL module/core, GLTFLoader, OrbitControls and
BufferGeometryUtils. Addon imports of `three` are rewritten to the local module
path; implementation is otherwise unchanged. No CDN, external textures or
runtime package fetches. Retain the license when redistributing.
